lesson.learning_objective: Understand the precise meaning of Ik Oankar
lesson.title: Ik Oankar: The Foundation
lesson.description: Learn the foundational concept of Ik Oankar and its profound meaning

block_data.text: Understand what Ik Oankar means in the context of Sikh philosophy.
This appears at the very beginning of Japji Sahib, establishing the foundational principle before all other teachings.

Ik Oankar is not a numerical statement about gods. It points to the unity of all existence—being, creation, and reality as one. The symbol ੴ combines "Ik" (one) with "Oankar" (the primal sound, the creative force), indicating that the One is both transcendent and immanent.

block_data.prompt: Which interpretation best reflects Ik Oankar?
options: It is a poetic symbol without meaning

feedback.0: Ik Oankar is not about counting gods, but about the nature of reality itself.
feedback.1: The teaching emphasizes unity, not separation between creator and creation.
feedback.2: Correct! Ik Oankar points to the fundamental oneness of all existence.
feedback.3: The symbol carries deep philosophical meaning about the nature of reality.

key_takeaways: Ik Oankar is not about counting gods, but about the nature of reality
It points to the fundamental unity of all existence
The One is both transcendent and immanent
This teaching challenges our sense of separation
